interpretationDecisions.topic: Numeric +9F / +4F captions after dash or whiff
interpretationDecisions.decision: Reported remaining advantage, not a prescribed nine-/four-frame wait. Removed invented waits; only the explicitly captioned delay throw retains an unquantified delay. Intentional framekill notation includes (whiff) so compact/copied inputs remain unambiguous.

Fine-frame review identifies forward jump, a heavy-kick input at 945.1, then landing guard against the recorded Ryu OD Shoryuken. The selected airborne moment is 945.2; no universal reversal coverage is claimed.
Authored only the actual Ryu Drive Reversal block, without asserting universal reversal coverage.
Frame/timing result, not a backward direction; performed sequence is dash then throw.
Enhanced specials explicitly marked and initial stock prerequisites authored separately. No ordinary special is silently substituted with an enhanced version.
Clips retain prerequisite knockdowns; input sequences begin with the follow-up. Prerequisite routes and extra Drive costs are separate.
